properties.name: Version claims moved 0.47.1 -> 0.48.0 for the v0.48.0 cut (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, reflow2.toml, AGENTS.md x2); nothing reflow2.toml declares about dependencies changed, only the number naming which reflow2 declares them. The design meaning of a cut lives in the Release and its epoch, not in a version string. ACCEPTED BEFORE THE MANIFEST FREEZES, deliberately — release_includes_all records each artifact's CURRENT checksum as shipped, so accepting afterwards would leave the release recording the pre-bump file (the flow's own forces-resync trap, budgeted on every cut before it was written down).
